d: Deep charcoal hair styled with long curls and straight bangs, paired with a mature face and sharp, blue-grey eyes. A slender build dressed in a burnt orange jacket over a white collared shirt with a yellow ribbon, a pleated navy blue skirt, white tights, and black lace-up heels. Accessories include a wide-brimmed tan hat with a silver feather ornament, white gloves, a dark brown leather satchel, and a navy blue folder.
